summary: Retain conservatively classified generic-PDF Email evidence in bounded FTS source comparisons.
decision_refs: The active objective requires accurate and adaptable project questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
An offline reproduction proved that the generic-document Email classifier accepted a To-plus-Subject fragment while its FTS family supplement rejected it
Aligning the existing bounded filter avoids a second index, dependency or broader semantic classifier
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: The supplement recognizes only the existing bounded Email signals; it does not infer that arbitrary PDF prose is an Email.
A generic document still needs a recognized first visible header plus a Subject header, while native EML/MSG and Email locators remain the preferred signals.
The change affects local evidence retrieval only and does not add mailbox synchronization, OCR, parsing or model calls.
